about.title: Designer. Writer. Developer.
about.quote:
I build what I used to have to explain.
From idea to design to working code.
about.bio1: I love it when something just works. When an idea, a design and the execution fit together seamlessly.
about.bio2: My path was anything but straight. From the Gerrit Rietveld Academie to SAE Institute and the Schrijversacademie, always searching for how to make something not just beautiful, but also understandable.
about.bio3: After years working in the automotive industry (Renault, Pieter Smit) and for clients like the Municipality of Amsterdam (graphic design and communications) and KLM (newsletters and blogs), I noticed something frustrating: I could see exactly what could be better… but I couldn't always build it myself.
about.bio4: So I decided to change that. I retrained as a Full Stack Developer at NOVI College. Because I no longer wanted a gap between idea and execution.
about.bio5: An idea, a business, something that needs to go online but nobody quite knows how? Tell me. I work out what is needed, design it, write the copy and build it myself. No detours, no separate specialists working past each other: one person, from first idea to the day it goes live. If something falls outside my field, I'll say so honestly. From idea to something that really works: that's what makes me happy.
about.journalCta: Curious how I think and work? In my journal I write about code, design and my path into development.

testimonials.label: What clients say
testimonials.title: Reviews
testimonials.sub: Real experiences from people I have worked with.

saskia.quote: Professional, decisive and collaborative! A breath of fresh air. And great that she dares to think 'out of the box'. I recommend Manon 100%!

marie.quote: During my recovery (I headbutted a mountain in the Alps and rattled my brain), I told ManonIT that I wanted to give my creative stories and ideas a place on my own website. She took care of everything from there. She asked about my wishes regarding style, setup and background, and built it faster than I could type. Now that my website is live, all I can say is: Manon, thank you for listening, for building, for rebuilding after good consultation, and of course for the aftercare with an extensive manual! I dreamed it up, ManonIT built it.

villa.quote: I thought we just needed a few pages. Manon kept asking questions until she could tell the story of Villa Vredestein better than I could at the bar. The result: a site with no frills, exactly like us, yet surprising enough to keep visitors reading longer than planned. Then she went and built a rental dashboard for our student rooms too, complete with payments, contracts and a cleaning schedule, and suddenly I had no spreadsheet left to curse at.

subscription.label: Subscription
subscription.title: A website without a big investment up front
subscription.intro: Would you rather pay a fixed monthly price than a large amount at once? Choose a subscription: design, build, maintenance, backups and changes are included.
subscription.noOther: The client pays the hosting costs (about €8 to 15 a month) and the domain (about €12 to 15 a year) directly to the provider. This applies to a subscription and to a project. With a subscription, maintenance, backups and security updates are included in the monthly price.

start.name: Start
start.tagline: Professionally online, with its own design.
items: Designed on my own design system, in your branding

growth.name: Growth
growth.tagline: A custom design that fits you.

brand.name: Brand
items: Custom design plus branding check or logo refresh
4 small changes per month plus quarterly check

terms: No lease: after 24 months your website is yours. If you then want to keep maintenance and changes, the subscription continues and you can cancel monthly.
You can stop earlier. You then pay off the remaining build part, about €20 to 30 per remaining month.
A small change means replacing text or an image, 15 minutes at most. It cannot be saved up. Bigger work gets a fixed price in advance.
Your domain is always in your name.
subscription.sketch: After the intro call I make a free sketch of your homepage: how your site could look. You see what you get before you decide anything, and you're not committed to anything.
subscription.more: Need more, such as a web app with login and database (like CasaCrew), a web shop or fully custom work? See the project prices below.

items.q: Are there any other costs?
items.a: Yes: hosting and domain. Hosting costs about €8 to 15 a month and the domain about €12 to 15 a year, both paid directly to the provider, with a subscription as well as with a project. With a subscription, maintenance, backups and security updates are included in the monthly price. All prices exclude VAT.

items.q: Why is this more expensive than a cheap subscription or Wix?
items.a: With cheap subscriptions you get a standard site that stays with the provider. With me you get a design that fits your style, with copy and build from the same person, and after 24 months the website is yours.

items.q: How is billing done?
items.a: Monthly. The monthly fee is invoiced each month; the one-off setup fee is listed separately with each plan. All prices exclude VAT.

items.q: How long until the site is live?
items.a: From one week, depending on the size of the site. A small site is ready sooner than an extensive one. A concrete schedule follows after the intro call.

items.q: What is needed to get started?
items.a: Logos and photos, plus details for the copy, such as contact details, personal details and what should go on the site. If photos are missing, I work with regular photographers.

items.q: What kinds of websites are possible?
items.a: From a business site of a few pages to a blog, a booking site for a holiday home or rental property, a web shop, a client portal or a web app. What fits depends on what the site needs to do. That is discussed in the intro call.

items.q: Which site goes with which price?
items.a: A business site of a few pages: the Start subscription, or a project as Basic website (from €1,200). A blog or a site that can be managed by the owner: Website with CMS (from €2,450). A booking site with a booking module: the Brand subscription, or fully custom work. A web shop, client portal or links with other systems: Fully custom (from €4,250). All prices exclude VAT. For a project you always get a fixed-price quote first.

items.q: What is a CMS?
items.a: CMS stands for content management system: an admin area where text, photos and blog posts can be edited without programming knowledge. WordPress is the best-known example. A custom CMS can also be built.

items.q: What is the cost difference with and without a CMS?
items.a: Without a CMS a site is ready sooner and cheaper (Basic website from €1,200). Changes are then made by me, at an hourly rate or within a subscription. With a CMS (from €2,450) there is more build work and a custom design, and text, photos and blog can be managed by the owner. A custom-built CMS is part of Fully custom (from €4,250).

items.q: What is the term?
items.a: 24 months. After that the subscription can be cancelled monthly and your website is yours.

items.q: I'd rather not have a subscription.
items.a: Then look at the project prices: a website for a fixed amount, with no term. They are below under rates.

items.q: Can I stop earlier?
items.a: Yes. You then pay off the remaining build part, about €20 to 30 per remaining month. After 24 months that is no longer needed.

items.q: Can I expand later?
items.a: Yes, with a fixed price in advance. You can also move up to a bigger plan.

items.q: How do I cancel?
items.a: By email to lets@manonit.com with the end date you want. The notice period is one month.

items.q: Is the domain in my name?
items.a: Yes. Your domain is always in your name.

items.q: Can I use my existing domain?
items.a: Yes. The domain is moved using a transfer code (also called an auth code) from the current provider and stays in the client's name.

items.q: Can several domains be connected to the site?
items.a: Yes, for example a .nl and a .com that both point to the same site.

items.q: Is the domain name I want still available?
items.a: This can be checked with the SIDN domain checker (SIDN manages .nl). If the name is free, ManonIT registers it in the client's name.

items.q: What if you get ill or stop?
items.a: Your domain is in your name, backups are made daily and every site comes with a handover document. You can take everything with you.

items.q: Who writes the text?
items.a: I write it for you, based on our conversation. If you already have text, I'll work it in. That way your site sounds like you, without you facing a blank page.

items.q: Can I change things myself?
items.a: I make small changes for you, within your monthly changes. If you want to manage text, photos and blog yourself, a website with CMS from the project prices fits better.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the design?
items.a: Two revision rounds are included.

items.q: Will the site be found on Google?
items.a: That depends on the subscription and plan. Growth includes basic SEO and GEO, for visibility on Google and in AI search engines. What else suits Start and Brand is discussed in the intro call.

items.q: Where is the site hosted and how fast is it?
items.a: On professional, reliable hosting, with SSL. Backups and security updates are part of maintenance. The site is technically optimised for speed. The client pays the hosting costs. I'm happy to discuss details of the hosting provider in a conversation.

items.q: Can the site be multilingual?
items.a: Multilingual is part of the Brand plan. It is not included in Start and Growth.

items.q: Is the website secure?
items.a: Yes. Every site runs over a secure connection (SSL), security updates are part of the subscription and back-ups are made daily.

items.q: What happens in case of an outage or attack?
items.a: Thanks to the daily back-ups the site can be restored. With a maintenance plan the site is also monitored, so an outage is noticed immediately.

items.q: What about privacy and GDPR?
items.a: Every site comes with a cookie and privacy statement in line with the GDPR. The domain is registered in the client's name.
